reviews.text: A top-notch doctor, both professionally and, above all, personally. Meticulous and attentive, he always manages to put both our furry friends and us, the owners who are always worried about their health, at ease. His love and dedication to this work is evident in his eyes, as well as those of his staff. It's rare to find someone so competent and empathetic. Highly recommended to anyone seeking a highly skilled and dedicated doctor.

I absolutely recommend it. Dr. Massimo and his staff are among the best in Campania. Beyond their experience and skill, Dr. Massimo puts his heart and soul into it, and that's not for everyone. Dr. Emanuele is also very good and knowledgeable, and Rosa Flora and Tonia are kind and professional. I absolutely recommend it. Between my mother and I, we have four dogs, and I wouldn't take my beloved pets to "the first person you come across."
If you love your pets, bring them to Dr. Massimo and trust him and his staff.

We discovered Dr. Massimo's office years ago, and believe me, we've been inseparable ever since. Today, a few months later, I'm here to tell you about Milù, our cat. Due to severe kidney failure and two 3cm ovarian cysts, she endured a two-month ordeal of IVs and treatments. During that time, I saw people coming in and out of that office, and everyone complimented the staff. Dr. Massimo and Dr. Manuele cared for little Milù with so much love and passion. I still remember the doctor's words: "I couldn't sleep last night and was thinking about Milù, because her creatinine levels kept rising." Everyone was against this operation because, given her kidney failure, it was very risky. But he told us, "Guys, you have to take the risk, because I really think Milù's problem is these cysts." Today I'm here to write a huge thank you to all of you: Doctor Massimo, Doctor Manuele, the nurses, and all the staff. You're amazing! Milù's scar isn't even visible anymore, and I can say she's become even more playful than before. My little girl is now here next to me sleeping peacefully, and it's only thanks to you. 🙏🙏🙏🙏❤️
The doctor is a great animal lover. Friendly, welcoming, and thorough, not at all greedy. I'll be back.
Good morning, can anyone tell me if dermatitis can cause aggression in dogs? The dog is undergoing treatment, but we can't get close to him because he growls and wants to bite. What can I do?
Excellent veterinary practice. Dr. Massimo Venelante and his entire team are very skilled and competent professionals. You can tell he truly loves animals and puts their well-being first. Thank you.

We came all the way from Switzerland to Naples to see Dr. Massimiliano Venelante. And we haven't regretted it for a moment. Our little dog is our world, and we entrusted him solely to him. And the doctor exceeded all expectations: attentive, gentle, and 1000% professional. He explained everything to us in great detail, gave us clear instructions, and we left with complete peace of mind. Thank you so much for your work and for the heart and soul you put into it. There are very few doctors like him. We'll only ever return to you! 🐾❤️

In our city, we're talking about you all the time—we recommend him to every dog ​​owner we know. Even those who used to go to other clinics now want to book with him. Even if it means coming all the way to Naples, it's absolutely worth it!

Dr. Massimo handled a very delicate emergency with my dog, responding promptly and flawlessly. He's an extremely knowledgeable, attentive veterinarian, always ready to explain things clearly to us, his owners. His professionalism is rare, and he's highly recommended!
Humanity, professionalism, and competence. Highly recommended.

Dr. Rosario Massimiliano Venelante, experience, competence, and incredible humanity. When you arrive at the clinic, you feel like you're part of a family. The other doctors and all the staff are incredibly professional. You feel confident that everything possible will be done for our furry friends, and in the best possible way.

They got my Lillo back on his feet with extreme professionalism and experience.

A special thanks to the great neurologist, Dr. Testa.
Maximum seriousness, professionalism and willingness to help.
If I could give zero stars, I would. Refusing to see a dog with broken ribs because they'd be closed in 10 minutes. I won't add anything else, highly discouraged.

I've been going to this vet for years, and every time I find him to be competent, helpful, and above all, a sincere love for animals. Always attentive, precise, and humane, he manages to put both us and our four-legged friends at ease. It's rare to find someone so knowledgeable and empathetic. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a highly experienced and trustworthy vet.

Highly trained staff.

Dr. Massimo Venelante is the absolute best!
They saved my puppy from a nasty uterine infection, promptly operated on, super professional staff, Massimo Venelante n1

We met Massimo three years ago. Cody had undergone major surgery, and the treatment he was receiving, unfortunately, was making him worse. It was thanks to Massimo, his expertise, and his meticulous care, that Cody got better and better day after day, until he was finally healed. The treatment worked, and for that I am deeply grateful.
His rare professionalism, combined with a humanity and kindness, truly make a difference.
All the doctors are true angels, always present and caring. The staff is wonderful: competent, available, and they exude a sense of security and trust. It's clear they deeply love animals and treat them with such kindness and care.
The best part? Cody adores them all…🫠❤️
What can I say: an absolute reference for anyone who wants the best for their pets.
🥰
Thank you again from the bottom of my heart for everything. Especially for your support and the love you have for our four-legged friends.

I'm speechless when I can't express my gratitude to Dr. Massimiliano and Dr. Emanuele and their staff, who have been treating my four-legged friend Kiki, who has hemolytic anemia, for the past six months.
Their professionalism, kindness, and dedication have been incredible. They always listened carefully to my concerns and did everything they could to help my dog. Their empathy and understanding have made a difficult time a little easier!
Thank you so much 💕💕💕💕💕

I went to this clinic on a second visit, and I couldn't have made a better choice. Dr. Venelante, now simply Massimo, solved a problem with my dog's paw flawlessly. He has above-average compassion and empathy for animals, and who better than them knows who deserves it? Whether you're local or not (I'm not), I recommend you visit him without hesitation.

Great humanity and empathy.
Professionalism, dedication, and an immense love for animals.

Dr. Venelante is THE veterinarian, not just any veterinarian...
He is a doctor who has embraced his profession with immense seriousness and is completely dedicated to the well-being of animals.

He operated on my dog ​​and was practically perfect.
His staff did a great job in easing my anxiety during the operation, and for that, I also thank them so much for their enormous kindness and empathy...
The anesthesiologist answered all my questions with great professionalism, giving me even more confidence in the success of the surgery my dog ​​was about to undergo.
I wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone who cares about their life partner...

This is the veterinary practice I highly recommend. Dr. Massimo and his staff are highly competent, helpful, and empathetic—essential qualities. You can immediately sense the love and professionalism with which they work. The atmosphere is welcoming and they pay great attention to both animals and owners. Highly recommended!

Words and compliments are not enough to describe the entire team at this clinic. I can only say that they saved my poodle. Their unparalleled professionalism and kindness immediately gave me peace of mind and reassurance. Thanks to all of them, but especially to Dr. Massimo, who has always been a point of reference.
A very well prepared and very friendly team

Dr. Massimo is incredibly humane, experienced, and sensitive, yet not greedy. He cares about the health of animals and was incredibly supportive of the loss of my dog, Saphira. Thank you for the immense heart Dr. Massimo puts into caring for and caring for our animal friends.

I would like to extend a heartfelt thank you to Dr. Massimo, an extraordinary veterinarian who combines his extensive expertise with profound humanity and a sincere love for animals. During such a difficult time for me and my family, he accompanied me and my beloved dog with rare sensitivity and gentleness, offering comfort, respect, and understanding. His attentive presence and gentle care truly made a difference, transforming even pain into a memory of dignity and affection.
A heartfelt thank you also goes to his assistant Angela and all his wonderful staff: special people who, with their empathy, kindness, and helpfulness, always manage to create a welcoming and serene atmosphere, making us feel close and warm at all times.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for what you do every day, for the love you put into your work, and for the gentleness with which you care not only for animals, but also for their human companions. You are a precious source of inspiration, and I will always carry with me the gratitude for your humanity and professionalism.

The people who work at this clinic, starting with Dr. Massimo, are very friendly, both with owners and our four-legged friends. Since I'm not a veterinarian, I can't comment on their expertise, as I can't assess it. However, from my own experience, I can say that I've treated my two furry friends there, and I've been very satisfied from the very first moment. As for the diagnoses they gave my furry friends through touch, they were later confirmed by further tests, which, in my opinion, demonstrates a certain skill in understanding the problems their furry friends may face. From what I understand, people come from all over the province of Naples to have their pets examined by Dr. Massimo and his staff, and for this reason alone, my only criticism of this clinic is: get a slightly larger facility that can adequately accommodate "your patients" and their companions.
Dr. Venelante Massimo and his team were wonderful. They took care of my poodle with all their heart. Thanks again for everything.
Professionalism, competence, love, passion, and honesty. Five adjectives to describe what I encounter every time I entrust my furry friends to Dr. Massimo Venelante.

Dr. Massimo is a true gentleman, an excellent and dedicated professional who treats his patients with unconditional love and unwavering professionalism. His staff is fantastic, tireless, and always smiling. "Well done" is an understatement. They took care of my kitten, who arrived in terrible condition after receiving poor treatment at another center, where incompetence nearly led to her death. I still don't know if she'll be able to recover from the damage she suffered as a result of poor treatment, but I know she's now in excellent hands, where she'll surely receive loving care and total assistance. I will never stop thanking Dr. Massimo for his humanity, expertise, and passion for animals. Thank you to the entire staff, you are all wonderful.

I could never take my dog, a French bulldog, into different hands. Doctor Massimo examined him the first day I got him and it was love between them right away. Today he is almost three years old... I wouldn't change our doctor for anyone else, we only trust him... everyone is good, Angela is always available...

I took my poodle, Thiago, to
Doctor Massimo, in disbelief at everything that would happen next. After three months of treatment, Dr. Manuele Penne and Tonia, with their love and, above all, professionalism, saved Thiago from an infection following a lung lobectomy. A thank you is never enough for everything you've done.
Doctor Massimo and all
his staff are angels ❤️
It's best to book, as it's always crowded. But that means the doctors are doing a good job.

THERE'S NO ONE...TOP 100 PERFORM THEIR WORK WITH PROFESSIONALISM AND LOVE FOR OUR 4-ANGELS 🐾 🐾 AND VERY KIND STAFF. FIRST AND FOREGROUND, OUR SUPER COLLABORATOR ANGELA IS VERY SWEET AND WELCOMES ALL CUSTOMERS WITH A SMILE.
IN MY OPINION? MY COLLEAGUES HAVE ONLY TO LEARN FROM DOCTOR VENELANTE 🙏🏻🐾🐶 Alessandro and Annarita and their Furry Friends Adore You...🫶
The best in all of Naples
Number 1 in Naples, professionalism and courtesy.

Dr. Massimo is fantastic! He's an exceptional professional, and his deep love for animals is clearly evident. He identified our dog's problem and operated on him; thanks to him, our four-legged friend was saved. In addition to his skill, he's always very friendly, makes everyone feel at ease, and is incredibly helpful. We now consider him a friend in our family.

I've been a client of Doctor Massimo for 16 years, and I couldn't be more satisfied.
He has cared for my dog ​​with care, expertise, and dedication over the years, always demonstrating great professionalism and love for his work.
He's not just a veterinarian, but a go-to person for anyone who truly cares about the health and well-being of their four-legged friends.
Always available, empathetic, attentive to detail, and with a human approach that makes all the difference.
Thank you for all these years of excellent care. I couldn't imagine entrusting my pets to anyone else. ❤️❤️❤️
•From the Costagliola Family 🐾Black loves you so much 🐾

The best vet ever, I recommend him wholeheartedly. Massimo, besides being a great person, is a great vet. He takes care of the animals as if they were all his own children. He is always so kind, friendly, and always available. If you are looking for a safe place for your four-legged friend, then this is the right place!
Doctor Venelante and his entire staff are top notch both in terms of professionalism and in always being available to clients and their furry friends.
Everything is fine, doctor and collaborators.
Optimal
Professional
Dr. Massimo, besides being an exceptional doctor, is also a very humane person, both with our little furry friends and with us anxious owners...

How disgusting, GUYS, RUN AWAY FROM THIS FOOL! Zero professionalism!!! They don't like animals.....we gave him a second chance after he blamed his co-worker for a very serious mistake. NEVER AGAIN IN MY LIFE!!! BUT NOW I'LL EXPLAIN EVERYTHING TO YOU WELL!!!!

I was disappointed!!! I had a problem with my dog, they told me they couldn't check him (even though I was a customer), they didn't even give me any medicine to address the problem, despite my insistence!!! It could have been a serious problem, having trusted the vet, I wanted him to help me or at least, I could have gone to the office as a last visit! Unfortunate response: Take him to the clinic!! I was disappointed!! ESPECIALLY BY THE RUDENESS AND UNPROFESSIONALISM!!

Today I feel compelled to write this review to share the incredible experience I had with Dr. Venelante and his fantastic staff. My dog, Maggie, a Cavalier King Charles Spaniel puppy, wasn't feeling well, so I decided to take her to Dr. Venelante, and I was truly blown away by his professionalism and expertise.

As soon as we arrived, the welcome was warm and reassuring, but what struck me most was the human and sensitive approach of the doctor and his staff. Not only did they gently reassure my dog, but they also took the time to explain every step of the visit to me, making me feel completely at ease.
I can highly recommend Dr. Venelante to anyone in need of a competent, attentive, and truly passionate veterinarian. Thanks to him, my Maggie is doing great, and I feel much more at ease, knowing I can count on such a knowledgeable and caring person for the future.

"There aren't
enough words to thank you for your commitment, your kindness, and your ability to care not only for animals, but also for the hearts of those who love them. You are a veterinarian with a huge soul."
Now that the doctor has vaccinated me, mom bought me a trendy sweatshirt and jacket 😁 …

An exceptional staff... Massimo is a humble, professional doctor and every dog ​​I have had he has always saved and given the right diagnosis, he is 100% complete I recommend him to anyone who wants to be in good hands, because our four-legged friends are children to us, and children must also be happy with those who take care of them....

Very clean clinic, they are very kind. I took my little Momo yesterday for a teeth cleaning. They were thorough and did all the necessary tests. The staff is excellent, the doctor is excellent, the atmosphere is excellent, I highly recommend it. Thank you so much! If you have pets and love them, you should treat them like children, and they should get the best of themselves. Without us, they're lost. Have a nice day!

I brought my dog ​​here with severe gastroenteritis, which was promptly diagnosed by Dr. Venelante and treated with care, dedication, and love by the doctor and the staff nurses, who were also well-trained and very kind.
Competent and humane doctor.
So much professionalism and kindness...you are unique 💗 …
Very kind professionals with a big heart

We've visited many veterinary practices since we got our cat, but upon arriving here, we immediately sensed a completely different atmosphere, starting with the facility: impeccable, tidy, clean, and well-organized.
But the real difference, of course, is made by Dr. Massimo and his team. Even during busy times, they manage everything flawlessly with great professionalism, patience, kindness, and humanity.
Their approach to young patients is exceptional, even the most difficult ones like ours, who simply didn't want to be seen. Their genuine interest in their health is immediately apparent, and that's not a given.
For us, he's become a guarantee; Dr. Massimo has immediately earned our complete trust and respect! ❤️🐾

My experience was excellent. The doctor and all the staff were very kind and helpful. I brought a kitten for sterilization. The procedure went well and I'm very satisfied. I'll be back.
I recommend it 100%.
Can anyone tell me when the veterinary practice will open? Thanks.
Competent doctors, especially Dr. Massimo Venelante, a conscientious and humane person towards animals with absolute competence, I highly recommend to everyone

Dear Doctor, I would like to express my deepest gratitude for the SKILL, professionalism, and humanity you demonstrated during Nuvola's treatment 💕, saving his LIFE! THANK YOU from the bottom of my heart 💓. …
